## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun test` passes locally
- [ ] `bun run lint` passes (no new TS errors introduced)
- [ ] Updated relevant docs (`docs/`, `README.md`, or inline)
- [ ] Added a migration if new tables/columns were introduced
- [ ] Updated `.env.example` if new env vars were added
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` for user-facing changes
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or personal data committed
- [ ] Commits follow the repo's commit-message style (`feat(scope): …`, `fix(scope): …`, etc.)
